newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 15.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The UAE has achieved 90 percent self-sufficiency in dairy products, poultry, vegetables, fruit and animal fodder, an official report said.
- Organisers say defence companies have already booked 78 percent of the indoor space for the International Defence Exhibition in Abu Dhabi in 1999.
- Following Sunday's closing of the Emirates Equity Fund initial offer at par, units in the fund will be available to the public at an offer price determined by the net asset value from June 19.
- Two former BCCI executives were released after completing their sentences in an Abu Dhabi jail.
- The fourth International Defence Exhibition, IDEX '99, will be held from March 14 to 18, 1999, an official said.

- Stong investor response to the UAE's first mutual fund, the Emirates Equity Fund, has prompted the fund manager, Emirates Bank International, to consider expanding the size of the fund from 100 million dirhams to no more than 200 million.
- The value of Sharjah's foreign trade rose from 8.2 billion dirhams in 1995 to 9.8 billion in 1996, a report by the Sharjah Customs Department said.
- The organisers of the IDEX defence exhibition announced the introduction of TRIDEX '98, a specialised defence show which will complement IDEX.
